caption:
Medical bills on a credit card? 🏥
CNBC reports that when bills get paid with cards or loans, they get recorded as that other debt, so it's hard to see how much is really medical. One counselor calls it "shadow debt."
Before borrowing: check for errors and ask about financial assistance.
Has a medical bill ever ended up on your card?
first_comment: Did you know to ask about financial assistance before paying a hospital bill? 👇
